status: 0.79.13 OPEN: T2 display RAMHT/resources and private CE table upload integrated; no task or acceptance closed
scope: Explicit internal Device/GSP runtime API. Bound instance, owned VRAM DMA contexts and confirmed private CE upload, before display channels start. Display rings still empty; no automatic activation, mode adoption or display method producer. Passive bootfb remains default.

facts.layout: GA106 uses GA102 display RAMHT size8192 and GV100 physical DMA object format. 1024 eight-byte buckets, XOR hash with user CHID, bounded linear probing, 64 contexts at offsets8192+i*32. Original24-byte descriptors are placed at32-byte stride; total transfer10240 bytes within the retained64KB instance. Pitch/small-page/rw flags0x45 VRAM or0x46 coherent SYS; 256-byte address/limit units and a conservative40-bit extent.
facts.resources: Heap-owned table reserves unique child names and independently imports/holds native VRAM backing through real device-use leases. Closing the producer does not release a reachable context. Runtime validates actual root classes, window mask, epoch/client/device/adapter and source identity. Coherent-SYS descriptor layout is covered; an owned notifier context is still software work.
facts.upload: Existing graph control allocation supplies12288-byte CPU-WB staging, zeroed and filled with the10240-byte revision. CPU unmap precedes a real GPU device-read lease. Existing C7B5/C6B5 channel uploads to the held native instance VA. Exact Device admission binds owner, table revision/digest, both buffers, channel, ticket, deadline, GPFIFO and actual encoded CE operands including release destination.
facts.publication: Only the real CE ring semaphore/SYS-flush completion path publishes a revision after releasing the staging read lease. GPGet or timeout cannot publish it. Queued GSP faults are processed first. The private transfer has no fabricated common-queue job or fence; normal CE queue work/RM factories/output refresh are serialized against it.
facts.table_updates: Initial revisions are writable only before any display channel is created. A root latch remains set after channel Free. Updating a live table requires a future physical display-quiescence/transition protocol; idle RM or CE alone cannot establish that condition.
facts.errors: Pre-submission memory rejection or deadline can cancel staging and retry without a GPU submit. Ambiguous leases, failed unmap/release, bad state, queued faults or post-submit timeout retain staging, contexts, instance, names and the surrounding firmware/boot graph. Channel retirement alone does not prove that the last scanout image is no longer fetched.
facts.diagnostics: Display table status exposes entries/revision/published revision/upload state. Failure logs preserve those fields and held staging; the existing journal records private CE points and source/target address correlation without inventing a public queue fence.

validation.reference: Eight pinned full Nouveau originals and complete notices archived. Original C hash/search/update/insert and GV100 binder/flags produce64 colliding entries with table-end wrap, VRAM/SYS targets and a40-bit upper boundary. Full10KB instance image matches Zig byte for byte; fixture12296 bytes.
validation.device: Seven scenarios added inside the existing actual Device test: success, GPU timeout, already queued firmware fault, CPU-unmap failure, device-read release failure, pre-submit acquire rejection/retry and pre-submit deadline/retry. Exact owner/lease/table/command/deadline admission, GPGet-before-completion, held creator-close resources and channel sealing are covered.
validation.guest: No repeated QEMU run: Kernel, SDK, Contract and common display/queue APIs unchanged.
validation.limits: Host tests establish software behavior, not physical GPU execution or visible scanout. Notifier ownership, display methods, PUT/completion, own presentation buffers, mode adoption/commit and rollback remain software work.

sources.fixture: Original hash/search/update/insert and GV100 bind functions extracted verbatim; original flags statements; host allocation/I/O stubs only.

attribution.notice_normalization: Only trailing whitespace in added notices; all prior bytes unchanged
